user_content_interaction.question: Does the app natively allow users to interact or exchange content with other users through voice communication, text, or sharing images or audio?

user_content_primary.question: Is shared, user-generated content the primary source of content in the app?

sharing_nudity.question: Does the app permit the public sharing of nudity?

nudity_primary_focus.question: Is this (sharing of nudity) the primary focus of the app?

user_content_graphic_violence.question: Does the app permit the public sharing of real-world, graphic violence outside of a newsworthy context?

user_content_block.question: Does the app include the ability to block users or user-generated content?

user_content_report.question: Does the app include the ability to report users or user-generated content?

chat_moderation.question: Does the app include chat moderation?

interactions_invited_only.question: Can interactions in the app be limited to invited friends only?
